record.field: Complete process for handling customer orders from receipt to delivery

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn"> <bpmn:process id="OrderFulfillmentProcess" isExecutable="false" name="Order Fulfillment Process"> <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order Received"> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing> </bpmn:startEvent>
<bpmn:task id="Task_ValidateOrder" name="Validate Order"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing> </bpmn:task>
<bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderValid" name="Order Valid?"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Valid</bpmn:outgoing> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invalid</bpmn:outgoing> </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
<bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process Payment"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Valid</bpmn:incoming> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing> </bpmn:task>
<bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare Shipment"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing> </bpmn:task>
<bpmn:task id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship Order"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing> </bpmn:task>
<bpmn:task id="Task_RejectOrder" name="Reject Order"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invalid</bpmn:incoming> <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing> </bpmn:task>
<bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderShipped" name="Order Shipped"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming> </bpmn:endEvent>
<bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderRejected" name="Order Rejected"> <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming> </bpmn:endEvent>
<!-- Sequence Flows --> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_ValidateOrder" /> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ValidateOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderValid" /> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Valid" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderValid" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment" /> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invalid" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderValid" targetRef="Task_RejectOrder" /> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment" /> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder" /> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderShipped" /> <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_RejectOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderRejected" /> </bpmn:process>
<bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_OrderFulfillment"> <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_OrderFulfillment" bpmnElement="OrderFulfillmentProcess"> <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_OrderReceived_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_OrderReceived"> <dc:Bounds x="152" y="102" width="36" height="36" /> <bpmndi:BPMNLabel> <dc:Bounds x="132" y="145" width="76" height="14" /> </bpmndi:BPMNLabel> </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_RejectOrder_di" bpmnElement="Task_RejectOrder"> <dc:Bounds x="500" y="200" width="100" height="80" /> </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

<bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_OrderRejected_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_OrderRejected"> <dc:Bounds x="652" y="222" width="36" height="36" /> <bpmndi:BPMNLabel> <dc:Bounds x="632" y="265" width="77" height="14" /> </bpmndi:BPMNLabel> </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
<!-- Edges --> <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_1_di" bpmnElement="Flow_1"> <di:waypoint x="188" y="120" /> <di:waypoint x="240" y="120" /> </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_Invalid_di" bpmnElement="Flow_Invalid"> <di:waypoint x="420" y="145" /> <di:waypoint x="420" y="240" /> <di:waypoint x="500" y="240" /> <bpmndi:BPMNLabel> <dc:Bounds x="429" y="190" width="15" height="14" /> </bpmndi:BPMNLabel> </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_3_di" bpmnElement="Flow_3"> <di:waypoint x="600" y="120" /> <di:waypoint x="650" y="120" /> </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

<bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_6_di" bpmnElement="Flow_6"> <di:waypoint x="600" y="240" /> <di:waypoint x="652" y="240" /> </bpmndi:BPMNEdge> </bpmndi:BPMNPlane> </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram> </bpmn:definitions>
